notes.title: Global Release Timing For “SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance”
notes.notes:
The release date of SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance is fast approaching on August 29th! Get prepared by knowing the release time in your region.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493128/d0d55991f61f1007036bd1ac46f1ca984fbac21c.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]And don't forget:

①Don't want to wait until August 29th? Pre-order the Digital Deluxe Edition to play three days early!
Also receive the Starter Pack, Digital Art Book & Soundtrack, and SEGA Villains Stage DLC, featuring Dr. Eggman and 2 guest bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1225326/"][/dynamiclink]
②Pre-order and save 10% 
In addition, as a pre-order bonus, you will receive  the Original Arcade Outfit and Fortune Hunter Amulet.


③Free Demo available now!
Play an enhanced version of the first stage, Oboro Village.  Enjoy a thrilling challenge with enhanced ninja abilities, greater enemy variety, unlocked hidden paths and a modified shop system. Once you've conquered the stage, push your skills further by replaying it in Arcade Mode and aim for the highest score.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489510/"][/dynamiclink]
